jobs.prompt: Correct this BrineSpace L-shaped counter artwork. Two essential changes: 1. EXACT square-room contact geometry: the far outer LEFT silhouette is one perfectly VERTICAL straight line, identical x coordinate from top to bottom. The outer TOP rear edge is perfectly HORIZONTAL, identical y coordinate across the top. These meet at a square screen-space 90 degree upper-left corner. No taper, no slant, no perspective convergence, no protruding feet or countertop beyond those wall-contact lines. It must fit against screen-aligned north and west walls, not diagonal walls. 2. Furniture currently too tiny/low: keep overall outer L footprint and arm lengths about the same but make each working-surface wing about 30 percent WIDER inward, cabinet FRONT FACES about 50 percent TALLER, and accessories about 25 percent larger. Show a substantial standing-height cabinet assembly, not a thin floor ledge. Resolve the long left return's inner supporting cabinet face clearly, while preserving vertical outer wall-contact edge and empty lower-right concave floor area. Keep overhead/cutaway view, visible useful worktops, neutral gray matte hand-painted materials and simple readable seams. Preserve tool tray, couplings and olive parts case on top with practical empty work space. All accessories inside footprint. Full silhouette on true transparent background with margins and transparent inner corner. No room, actual walls, floor, outside shadow, people, text, shine, glow or dense texture. Pixel-art-game prop export around 345 pixels wide but retain our painted style rather than coarse pixel blocks.
